title: Herbed {p} with {v}
steps: Toss the {p} with the {spice}, a little olive oil and salt, and leave at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Sear the {p} in a very hot grill pan or skillet 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned and {doneness}. Check with a thermometer.
Rest the {p} 5 minutes, then slice across the grain.
Pile the {v} and the {s} on plates, top with the lamb, and drizzle with the {sauce}.
tip: Trim the fat, keep the lamb to a palm-size portion, and fill half the plate with the greens.
